name: CS 161 'Week N (Mon–Fri)' headers with weekday-only rows
text:
CS 161 — Data Structures and Algorithms
Fall 2026 · Section 02 · MWF 1:30–2:20 PM · Gates B01
Instructor: Prof. Raj Menon (rmenon@univ.edu)
TAs: Priya S., Tom W. — sections Thursday 4:00 PM

Grading
  Programming assignments (6) .......... 36%
  Weekly quizzes (Fridays, lowest dropped) .......... 10%
  Midterm ......................... 20%
  Final ........................... 30%
  Participation ................... 4%

Programming assignments are due at 11:59 PM on the day listed. Five late days total.

Schedule
Week 1 (Aug 24–28)
  Mon: Course overview, asymptotics
  Wed: Arrays and linked lists
  Fri: Stacks and queues; PA1 released
Week 2 (Aug 31–Sep 4)
  Mon: Amortized analysis
  Wed: Hashing I
  Fri: Hashing II — Quiz 1
Week 3 (Sep 7–11)
  Mon: Labor Day, no class
  Wed: Trees and BSTs; PA1 due
  Fri: Balanced trees
Week 4 (Sep 14–18)
  Mon: Heaps
  Wed: Priority queues
  Fri: Heapsort — Quiz 2
Week 5 (Sep 21–25)
  Mon: Graph representations
  Wed: BFS/DFS; PA2 due
  Fri: Topological sort — Quiz 3
Week 6 (Sep 28–Oct 2)
  Mon: Shortest paths
  Wed: Dijkstra
  Fri: Review
Week 7 (Oct 5–9)
  Mon: MIDTERM (in class)
  Wed: Minimum spanning trees
  Fri: Union-find; PA3 due
Week 8 (Oct 12–16)
  Mon: Greedy algorithms
  Wed: Divide and conquer
  Fri: Master theorem — Quiz 4
Week 9 (Oct 19–23)
  Mon: Dynamic programming I
  Wed: Dynamic programming II; PA4 due
  Fri: DP on graphs
Week 10 (Oct 26–30)
  Mon: String algorithms
  Wed: Tries
  Fri: Quiz 5
Week 11 (Nov 2–6)
  Mon: Network flow
  Wed: Matching; PA5 due
  Fri: NP-completeness intro
Week 12 (Nov 9–13)
  Mon: Reductions
  Wed: Approximation
  Fri: Randomized algorithms — Quiz 6
Week 13 (Nov 16–20)
  Mon: Advanced topics
  Wed: PA6 due
  Fri: Review
Final exam: Monday, December 14, 1:30–4:30 PM
notes: Weekday-only rows resolve against the week header range (Mon = first day).
